title: General obligations of Data Fiduciary
original_clause:
(6) In the event of a personal data breach, the Data Fiduciary shall give the Board and
each affected Data Principal, intimation of such breach in such form and manner as may be
prescribed.
plain_language: If there's a personal data breach, the organization responsible for handling the data must inform the Data Protection Board and each person whose data was involved, in a way and form that the government rules will specify.
key_points: Data Fiduciary must inform about data breach
Must notify Board and affected individuals
Inform must be in a specified form and manner
Details of form and manner to be prescribed by government rules
disclaimer: This is general information about the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023, not legal advice. Check the original text or consult a qualified lawyer before acting on it.
